page.overview:
What is muggle-born?

A Muggle-born was a witch or wizard who was born to two non-magical parents. Their magical abilities did not seem to be at all affected by their Muggle parentage. On the contrary, many Muggle-borns were among the most talented witches and wizards of their age, such as Lily Evans and Hermione Granger.

Muggle-borns were called No-Maj-born in the United States of America, once known as a Magbob, and also known by the pejorative Mudblood. By refusing marriage with Muggles and Muggle-borns, the pure-blood families are shrinking in size and number.

Muggle-borns inherited magic from a distant ancestor; they were descended from Squibs who had married Muggles and whose families had lost the knowledge of their wizarding legacy. The magic resurfaced unexpectedly many generations later. Magical children born to non-magical parents, with at least one parent being a child of a Squib, are considered Muggle-born.

Because of the heritable traits of magic, Muggle-born siblings were possible, as in the case of Colin and Dennis Creevey. However, this was not always the case, as Lily Evans's sister Petunia was a Muggle.
